statements.proposition: The new scripts/terraform/deploy.py wrapper keeps the existing deployment workflow working (the documented 'terraform apply, then python deploy.py' flow behaves as before).
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Read from diffs only; nothing was run (needs Azure). Documented workflow at base: terraform plan/apply, then 'python deploy.py' (non-interactive, reads terraform outputs, configures the VMs over ssh). After the change deploy.py is an interactive wrapper that prompts for resource group, prefix and region and then calls deploy_unified.py deploy, which provisions with Terraform itself. The old behaviour was moved to deploy_legacy.py, so it is preserved under another name, not under the entry point users were told to run. Also old deploy.py functions (setup_aiopslab, run_command, etc.) no longer exist in deploy.py. Scope of 'existing workflows' is a judgment, and the Ansible playbooks/Terraform variables were left compatible (new variables have defaults), so a reader could weigh this differently.
evidence: Base README.md (3da0021) step 6: 'python deploy.py' after 'terraform apply main.tfplan', to set up AIOpsLab on the provisioned resources
PR patch scripts/terraform/deploy.py: 238 lines removed, 87 added; new main() uses input() prompts for Resource Group Name, Prefix, Region and runs deploy_unified.py deploy
Change list: deploy_legacy.py added (239 lines) holding the old flow; variables.tf adds create_resource_group (default false) and subscription_id (default empty)
